name: Backprop layer-forward tree reduction
description: Shared-memory power-of-two-stride tree reduction computing a weighted partial sum per hidden node, from a backpropagation network's input-to-hidden layer-forward pass (HEIGHT=WIDTH=16, in=8192).
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: bpnn_layerforward_CUDA reproduced verbatim from Rodinia backprop_cuda_kernel.cu. The host driver, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new; deterministic gen_input/gen_weight are inlined into the host. Snapshot sk-02.
notes: Real-extraction tree-reduction case from collection snapshot sk-02. in=8192, hid=16, num_blocks=512 -> 8192 output floats. CPU reference replicates the exact float32 tree-reduction add order.
